name: sinblocker
description: A Chrome Manifest V3 extension that hides images, videos, and background media on the sites you choose.

scripts.build: npm run clear && npm run src-copy && npm run src-css && npm run src-minify-html
scripts.clear: rm -f extension/popup.html extension/popup.js extension/options.html extension/options.js extension/onboarding.html extension/onboarding.js extension/background.js extension/content.js extension/store.js extension/main.css
scripts.src-minify-html: html-minifier --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --output extension/options.html extension/options.html && html-minifier --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --output extension/popup.html extension/popup.html
scripts.src-package: npm run build && python3 scripts/package.py pack
